title: Why standing desks beat sitting

title: Your body was built to move
body: Long stretches of sitting stiffen your hips and slow your blood. Standing for part of the day keeps you loose and your posture honest.
notes: FALLBACK DECK. Shift your weight from foot to foot while you say this. It lands better when you look like you mean it.

title: Standing keeps you sharp
body: People who stand get to the point faster and slump less after lunch. Alternate sitting and standing, and finish the day with something left.
